original_findings.issue: Per-socket completion timeout did not bound template/tokenization/whole response I/O.
original_findings.resolution: Linux main-thread SIGALRM encloses full generate; finite positive budget required, preexisting timer or blocked signal refused, remaining time checked, prior handler restored.

original_findings.issue: Duplicate task descriptors, missing boundary identity costs and insufficient family/registration binding could admit aggregate gates.
original_findings.resolution: Exact unique task/stratum/arm/model descriptors; unknown identity costs remain null and block gates; cohort binds scheduled model/protocol/registration/source/tool/runtime, recomputes summary and compares retained CELL and BOUNDARY records.

original_findings.issue: Failure after superclass process creation but before constructor return could leave an unassigned owned server.
original_findings.resolution: Post-super constructor work catches BaseException, closes owned server and preserves original error including cleanup diagnostics.
